source_findings.idea: pp3–4: 30-minute letters, A 09:30–10:00, B 10:00–10:30; time POC/VAH/VAL

A 30-minute visit does not prove fast movement; test measured traversal time and competing fill/continuation outcomes. Final usage sentence clipped; unresolved, not invented.

source_findings.idea: p8: IB = first hour A+B; extension signals control/trend
source_findings.rationale: Retain first-hour object and sequential extension events. IB is computable from price data, not exclusive to TPO as claimed. 'IB holds = normal or neutral' conflicts with AM1 neutral both-side extensions. source_findings.rationale: Retain alternative rotational and expansion path hypotheses; source does not define 'early'. Freeze candidate timings in training and compare soft probabilities to hard gates, with remaining excursion and costs.

source_findings.rationale: Retain level, slope and conditional regime features. Trending versus rotating is a separate target from magnitude; estimate joint distributions, not automatic regime labels. Primary Cboe methodology verification required.

Improve with calibrated realized range/excursions conditional on spot level, tenor, session and risk premium; compare 252/365 conventions rather than claiming either creates a true range forecast.

source_findings.idea: p4: VIX12.5→ES30pt/scalp3–5;16→50pt/target10;22→95pt/partials/trail

source_findings.idea: p5: realized/implied range completion means fuel spent
source_findings.rationale: Retain completion ratio as a predictor. Reject a finite fuel assumption; large early range may forecast more future volatility. Model remaining high/low and continuation conditional on path, events and jumps; test against elapsed-time baseline and tail exceedances.

source_findings.idea: p6: ES up/VIX down continuation; up/up caution; down/up risk-off; flat/flat chop; simplified fallingVIX→balance

Audit actual intraday VIX availability; daily observations cannot supply this feature. Hedging-demand story is not identified from co-movement alone.

source_findings.idea: p7: pre-event vol rise, avoid over-fading/ignore range; post-event crush, return to rotations
source_findings.rationale: Retain scheduled-event phase and measured IV change, distinguish anticipation, surprise and realized aftermath. Catalyst days can exceed forecasts; post-event trend is also possible. Compare conditional mixture forecasts to calendar-only and unconditional models; respect event publication/revision times.

source_findings.idea: p8: contango/backwardation, VVIX rise as warning; stress reduce size/widen
source_findings.rationale: Retain separate VX futures curve, spot VIX term structure and VVIX; source conflates these under 'VIX curve'. Define exact maturities/roll and basis, test incremental forward information without assuming VVIX reliably leads or levels become meaningless. Daily-only feeds constrain cadence; one-mini reduction means abstention.

source_findings.idea: pp9–10: balance+fallingVIX fade value→POC; balance+risingVIX prepare break; fallingVIX smaller breakout
source_findings.rationale: Merge into auction×volatility interaction experts and location ranking, benchmark strict rules against calibrated joint forecasts. Do not impose confluence eligibility; tests must separate forecast quality, level choice and eventual trade economics.

source_findings.idea: pp3–4: bids, asks, aggressive versus passive
source_findings.rationale: p3 actual DOM EPZ25 has separate volume-at-price, resting size and executed bid/ask columns, largest displayed volume15325 at6660.75 and BBO near6659.50/75; static snapshot cannot show reload. source_findings.idea: p5: delta per price = aggressive buy−sell; positive delta with no progress

Use equation and actual trades, not calibrated graphic values. Retain signed-volume profiles and effort/progress discrepancy; observed prints do not establish trader identity or held positions.

source_findings.idea: p6: tape pace and spread modify level reaction
source_findings.rationale: Retain trade-count/volume intensity, acceleration, drought, spread and BBO depletion as separate Context and candidate-quality features. Fast approach can break OR absorb; frozen tape alone cannot prove absorption. One-tick spread does not establish depth health. Compare interaction models with intensity, spread and time-of-day baselines; future execution impact accounted separately.

source_findings.idea: pp7–8: level→aggression→hold/reload/pull→delta→tight entry
source_findings.rationale: Faithful sequence benchmark, future Response catalogue. User USR06 permits entries from Context+Location; do not impose DOM confirmation or source claim that order flow cannot create locations. source_findings.idea: p3: resistance attack, heavy buys absorbed, quick reversal/trap
source_findings.rationale: Retain high signed effort/low progress followed by rejection; distinguish as-of stall from future reversal label. Retail/institution identity and 'highest quality' unsupported. Compare continuation, stall and reversal hazards conditioned on prior level/path; retain failures instead of selecting only turns.

source_findings.idea: p4: reset counts before arrival; fake break→fast rejection; 300 orders across3ticks
source_findings.rationale: Retain event-anchored local flow and zone integration, separately from session memory. Threshold300/3ticks is an example; units order count versus contracts ambiguous. Benchmark deterministic reset on approach, rolling/decayed and event-segmented accumulators; avoid discretionary hindsight reset.

source_findings.idea: p5: bid/ask stacking and pulling with delta
source_findings.rationale: 'Bid delta rises'/'ask delta rises' ambiguous and not equivalent to net trade delta; preserve separate quote-size additions/removals and signed executed volume. MBP1 cannot observe size pulling before a remote level becomes BBO. At unchanged BBO, net queue-size change adjusted for known trades is observable under feed assumptions; it cannot identify individual cancels/adds hidden within batching. Defer depth-wide variant pending richer feed.

source_findings.idea: p6: selling hits bid, defended/reloading level reverses up; positive delta no upward progress traps buyers
source_findings.rationale: Cartoon shows one enlarged cyan lower-side row; no temporal frames, transactions or scale to demonstrate reload. Retain both side-symmetric hypotheses, distinct from graphic proof. Resting size that vanishes need not have been fake; trade/quote chronology and missingness matter.

source_findings.idea: p7: absorption heavy volume/no movement; exhaustion falling volume/smaller pushes; stopping burst
source_findings.rationale: Retain separate effort, diminishing intensity and extreme burst specialists with common future path targets. Text says they 'point opposite ways' yet describes hard reversal versus pause/fade; not necessarily opposite directions. Compare learned interactions and multi-scale normalization rather than inferring one passive giant.

source_findings.idea: p3: reserve order examples10000/500 and20–30 displayed/hundreds executed
source_findings.rationale: Retain replenishment and executed/displayed ratio proxies, not true iceberg or institutional labels. source_findings.rationale: Preserve distinct future Response sequence and elapsed time. source_findings.idea: pp5–6: large wall cancelled; vanishing, flicker, unusual placement, fast cancels; check prints; wait for sustained liquidity
source_findings.rationale: Retain quote-lifetime/turnover and trade-conditioned stability as market-quality features where observable. Faithful defensive filter compared with calibrated adverse-selection model, not legal intent classifier.

source_findings.rationale: Catalogue separate multi-level correlated cancellation (unavailable MBP1) and BBO side-imbalance oscillation (observable proxy). source_findings.rationale: Retain trade/quote reconciliation and persistence measurement; reject universal authenticity guarantee. source_findings.idea: p3: per-candle bid/ask executed volume; no pace in completed footprint
source_findings.rationale: Retain trade-level spatial/time accumulation, with explicit bar/activity/event boundaries. Add within-bar trajectory, arrival intensity and uncertainty rather than compressing every fight to final candle.

source_findings.rationale: Text variously predicts overextended leader snapping back, weaker laggard falling more, and divergence resolving against laggard. source_findings.rationale: Retain planned loss, actual fill loss, open P&L and stop state separately. Stops do not guarantee a cap or locked profit under gaps, latency or failed orders; test execution stress independently of policy quality.

source_findings.rationale: Retain deterministic risk boundary and auditable management rules; arbitrary percent of advertised prop balance rejected as primary sizing. Compare stop/exit hypotheses later; one mini or flat and actual remaining account loss allowance apply.

source_findings.rationale: Merge into governance: candidate completeness, no outcome-driven discretionary overrides, change logs, abstention allowed. source_findings.idea: p6: stay/leave/return to balance; SP/balances objectives; avoid interior, prefer edges
source_findings.rationale: Retain causal auction-state transitions and target competition, with duration/acceptance measurements. source_findings.rationale: Retain reproducibility and full candidate logging, improve with frozen hypothesis registry, nested out-of-sample tuning and ablations. source_findings.idea: p4: probabilistic aggregate rather than next-candle certainty
source_findings.rationale: Retain probabilistic forecasts and distributional evaluation; rejecting certainty does not mean individual-event probabilistic prediction is impossible. Evaluate conditional next-event and horizon distributions, not deterministic promises.

source_findings.idea: p5: trend score, history-relative values, C-scores, standard deviations, macro cycles
source_findings.rationale: Retain measurable trend and point-in-time macro context where audited data supports it. C-score formula undisclosed; don't invent a reconstruction. source_findings.rationale: Preserve proposed feature families and historical comparison method; reject undated verdict and claim every bubble needs all named conditions. source_findings.rationale: Heading says activates on two-win streak but mechanics increases risk after first. source_findings.rationale: Retain explicit availability-time/label contract; next report may supervise aggregate changes after publication, never historical intraday input.

source_findings.rationale: Retain broad candidate universe, independent options locations and joint contextual selection. Observed frequent success unverified. Test modest and large nodes, fixed-density nulls, pre-contact rank and executable utility.

source_findings.rationale: Retain rich surface dynamics, contextual forecast experts and scenario-conditioned levels. Assertion Greeks useless without vol is too absolute; benchmark static and dynamic alternatives fairly.

source_findings.rationale: Retain aggregate OI prediction and downstream reaction loops separately. No evidence competitor is fixed formula or learned approach better. Require held-out gains at both stages,0DTE-specific treatment.

source_findings.idea: Context changes generator thresholds, updates and confidence intervals
source_findings.rationale: Retain conditioning at formation, width, persistence, expiry, selection and calibration—not only final threshold. Compare fixed generators and conditional variants with fold-local complexity control.

source_findings.idea: p13: LVN/shelf/ledge needs second transition to renewed balance; shelf gradual taper, ledge abrupt cutoff, tail one-sided
source_findings.rationale: Retain distinct shape, neighboring modes and transition/persistence features. Hypothetical short box shows19.75point risk,158target,8R; no executed outcome. source_findings.idea: pp14–16: balanced fade vs discovery continuation; HTF then LTF; checklist and promotion
source_findings.rationale: Retain context-conditioned path hypotheses and shared information lineage across DOM/footprint/heatmap; do not count displays as independent votes. Current user permits C/L entry before Response. Preserve faithful later sequence benchmark while testing whether confirmation adds net value after delay. Promo is not evidence; exact source algebra for AAPL heuristic remains unavailable.

source_findings.idea: pp3–4: volume at price, more time implies more volume; VA68%, POC maximum
source_findings.rationale: Retain separate volume, time-at-price and trade-intensity profiles. More elapsed time does not necessarily mean more traded volume when intensity varies. VA68% differs from70% lessons and40% intraday suggestion: preserve each benchmark with explicit construction/tie handling and train-only parameter selection. P4 final chart shows multiple excursions outside drawn VA and repeated POC crossings; it supplies no causal profile snapshots.

source_findings.idea: p5: POC magnet; repeated failure above → VAL; aggressive break through → VAH
source_findings.rationale: Retain distinct reach and post-POC conditional path hypotheses, including direction of approach and failed attempts. Reject guaranteed return to POC. Compare against midpoint/VWAP and distance-matched placebo targets; test C/L candidate entry and later aggression refinement separately. This mechanism complements Jumbo internal continuation, not only edge fades.

source_findings.idea: pp6,12: break → return inside for retest → continuation preferred over reversal
source_findings.rationale: Retain exact sequence benchmark, distinguish shallow edge retest from full reacceptance and opposite traversal. Higher win rate is personal unverified claim, not a system constraint. Test continuation and reversal by state, range origin, retest depth and remaining payoff after confirmation.

source_findings.idea: p7: balanced bell profile gives strongest levels
source_findings.rationale: Retain density geometry and both-edge rotations; visual has uneven subsidiary bulges despite 'even taper' prose. Strength superiority needs comparison with other families and nulls. Use continuous symmetry/multimodality/taper features and evolving state rather than a forced bell classification.

source_findings.idea: pp1,8: double distribution gives plan in advance
source_findings.rationale: Drawing shows upper balance → decline → lower balance → break ABOVE lower balance → retest its UPPER boundary → target LOWER boundary of upper balance across the thin bridge. This is more specific than prose 'lower shelf to upper extreme'; preserve both boundary identities, intermediate gap and chronology. Symmetric short after break/retest also retained. Test bridge traversal, failure back inside lower balance, and target-room selection, with all levels fixed or versioned as of decision.

source_findings.idea: p9: trending thin profile means nothing to trade
source_findings.rationale: Reject blanket no-trade rule; it is a discretionary profile-trader preference and conflicts with source continuation ambition and Jumbo trend opportunities. Retain repeated countertrend-entry failure risk and compare abstain/follow/retest policies in the same observed trend state. 'Entire session' trend is only a retrospective label; intraday gate must use prefix information.

source_findings.idea: pp10–11: P upper agreement after upward drive, B lower agreement after downward drive; wait for range break/retest with original trend
source_findings.rationale: Retain path-conditioned shape formation and continuation hypotheses; conflicts with MAV's P/B reversal interpretation, so neither becomes fixed rule. P drawing shows only impulse and pullback, not completed breakout/retest; B shows lower range rotations ending down. Test shape alone vs causal formation path plus current balance and flow.

source_findings.idea: pp12–13: checklist and theory half of series
source_findings.rationale: Merge source-fidelity checks and planned two-sided scenarios. Claims of theory do not establish performance; live-market companion remains separately reviewed, not evidence by reference.

source_findings.idea: pp3–5,10: partial exits at protected lows beat immediate breakeven on prop accounts
source_findings.rationale: Primary one-mini evaluation cannot partial. Retain full-position exit/hold/trail alternatives at these locations; reject universal EV ranking and breakeven=zero after costs. Compare static stop, causal swing trail, delta-conditioned trail and optional exit on new invalidation using the same entry paths.

source_findings.idea: pp4–5: rising price, dominant buying delta, microbalance escape, confirmed/protected low; below it sellers refill
source_findings.rationale: P4 schematic explicitly says sellers trapped and BUYERS protect the lower line, stop underneath and original entry still lower; prose inconsistently calls the last defense 'sellers'. Preserve observed side, not identity narrative. Confirmation cannot mean knowing price never returns: define elapsed displacement/closed-bar or causal swing confirmation and record its delay. Retain location memory, break-to-next-auction forecast, serial protected lows and re-entry eligibility with day budget. No claim actual same traders remain.

source_findings.idea: pp6–7: wick absorption can mislead; highest delta-profile print identifies rewarded side
source_findings.rationale: Retain separate delta concentration, latest burst, price location relative to that concentration and subsequent/so-far displacement. 'Highest point' is underspecified: highest price, strongest signed/absolute delta or profile peak differ. Original p7 marks a long leftward profile bar ABOVE short entry; white arrow starts at a green bubble during a decline, followed by more magenta bubbles. No legend/settings to identify exact aggregation. Do not assert the largest delta is automatically rewarded; test each explicit construction and reward measured independently from delta magnitude.

source_findings.idea: p7: actual short tickets and target hit
source_findings.rationale: Original shows short quantity−1, pending buy stop labelled−350USD, pending limit+670USD, current candles still ABOVE the target. It does not show a completed target fill despite prose. Axis/contract/time absent. Preserve as selected mechanism illustration only; fill claims require an execution log. Signed profile lines, total grey profile and trade bubbles are distinct representations; no inferred sizing formula.

source_findings.rationale: Retain ordered aggression-result memory and change-of-control hypotheses, but reject equivalence of trapped inventory, passive absorption and either exhaustion mechanism. 'Refill' here includes renewed directional success and is not necessarily queue replenishment. Pass rate has absent denominator/rules/raw history, not evidence. Compare repeat-defense, failure and role-reversal transitions with context and source-specific definitions; detailed entry policy deferred.

source_findings.idea: pp9–10: high delta at dealing-range LVN or MINOR node gives repeated intra-wick reactions on both sides
source_findings.rationale: Retain minor nodes as well as LVNs, anchor to the causal dealing range, associate contemporaneous delta and earlier reactions. It does not show target fill; pending stop has locked gain+230USD and pending limit+480USD, with current short P&L+290USD shown. Test node-only, delta-only, joint and matched-density nulls; wick scale, zone width and lookback train-only.

source_findings.idea: pp10–11: default to delta when it contradicts wick; repeat reaction checklist
source_findings.rationale: Retain disagreement as a measurable state, not mandatory priority of delta. C/L entry remains allowed before reaction; compare calibrated fusion, source-rule default and abstain. Promo and references add no verified performance; scope of unshown videos is unavailable supplied material, not unread pages.

source_findings.idea: Balance/imbalance alternation; value is VAH–VAL interval; prior value proposed as destination. Bell schematic p4 supplies no price/time calibration.
source_findings.rationale: Merge AM1/MAV/MAT into multiscale auction state and profile objects. Treat destinations probabilistically; neither exhaustive binary state nor literal fair fundamental valuation. Test prior versus developing value and age-conditioned reach.

source_findings.idea: Extremes require acceptance/rejection; HVN can stall, LVN can reject **or** be traversed quickly. p13 checklist drops the rejection alternative. p6 describes a lower fair value/upper extreme yet calls upward rejection sellers failing/buyers absorbing.
source_findings.rationale: Preserve approach direction and side separately; do not translate contradictory directional prose into a fixed rule. Profile shape is historical traded volume, not directly current liquidity. Context/Location forecast competing touch paths; Response later refines.

source_findings.idea: Failed auction: upper balance → sell into prior lower value → reject → return toward original range. Sketch shows upper floor break, touch middle horizontal reference, rebound; bottom line untouched. No POC label and rebound in sketch does not finish far-edge traversal.
source_findings.rationale: Retain as distinct broader failed-auction variant; MAV special requires prior POC whereas this source does not. Store reference kind and completion timestamps; test both definitions on identical cohorts.

source_findings.idea: After failed-auction reentry, claimed 80% far-edge traversal versus 20% internal ranging; repeated failed POC crossings favor ranging, aggressive crossing/holding retest favors traverse.
source_findings.rationale: Benchmark-only percentages, different denominator from MAV outside-open/two-period 80% rule. Merge POC paths with RVP failed-cross and Jumbo internal continuation experts but preserve individual targets. Test internal chop versus opposite edge and return to entry-side edge separately.

source_findings.idea: A deep penetration into prior balance can ultimately reject after slow buyer recovery; brief penetration alone is not acceptance.
source_findings.rationale: Retain depth, dwell, revisits and velocity as continuous histories; permit state changes. Do not label earlier acceptance wrong solely because it later reverses. Test path and horizon sensitivity.

source_findings.idea: Week-long value → upper brief value → decline through old value to lower reference narrative. Chart pink zigzag marks repeated approx 29,730–29,835 swings; later down-leg passes 29,730 to about 29,545, **then recovers to approx 29,824 at the right edge**, contrary to prose's current hold at lower extreme. Three profiles contain multiple humps and signed bars; anchors/date span not fully labeled.
source_findings.rationale: Retain old object reuse, penetration/reclaim, multi-distribution geometry and path-dependent expiry. Do not ban week-old levels (contrast MAT). Do not infer ongoing lower hold or causal anchor from this snapshot; last-price and publication freeze are needed. Chart illustrates both break and later reentry.

source_findings.idea: At range extreme, competing rejection/breakout; continuation may occur with retest or with **no retest**. Source also says no advance knowledge possible.
source_findings.rationale: Retain all path alternatives; certainty unavailable does not imply forecasts impossible. Context/Location may originate entries under user instruction; waiting competes economically.

source_findings.idea: Fast aggressive approach implies participants defend higher prices; slow approach implies weak interest and fade. Final sentences instead say fast-arrival level defended, slow-arrival level broken, with ambiguous orientation.
source_findings.rationale: Modified: signed approach speed, aggressive flow, displacement efficiency, distance traveled and range side are independent inputs. Test continuation versus exhaustion rather than copy ambiguous defended/broken direction. Interact with vol and prior aggression.

source_findings.idea: If prior balance low holds/bounces, no short in source method. Short sequence: break low → retest from below → renewed lower progress; failed seller retest flips bullish read.
source_findings.rationale: Preserve rule baseline and failure/reversal branch. Later Response registry plus current auction-transition probabilities; flip in belief is not automatic opposite trade. Compare break, first retest, failed retest and direct C/L entry.

source_findings.idea: Strong buying that fades allegedly leaves trapped buyers whose liquidation amplifies down move. Original image is NQ TPO tab with profiles, dates Aug4–12 2026, 09:30/18:00 markers; reference ~29,944; multiple excursions, no directly readable inventory/standalone delta trace.
source_findings.rationale: Retain aggression-decay and adverse excursion of past flow as proxy, reject observed trapped identity/forced-sale certainty. Compare delta persistence, return efficiency, retention assumptions and subsequent selling; plot alone does not verify the delta narrative.

source_findings.idea: Wait through old-balance chop, enter short only on aggressive break/retest with sellers regaining momentum. p8 crosshair near ~29,715 after a rebound from ~29,650 to ~29,800, then decline to ~29,545. p7 shows later rally and fresh decline; pages are not one unbroken chronological replay.
source_findings.rationale: Sequence requires timestamped same-object events; retest may overshoot the nominal ~29,730–740 strip substantially, so width/overshoot must be explicit. Keep abstention as action, not ban all balanced-regime opportunities. Claimed live trade is unverified without logs.

source_findings.idea: At HTF upper extreme, switch to 15m: selling achieves little, defended low/retest failure, then buyers rally. Chart ~29,830–845 strip repeatedly traversed, larger rightward rally past 30,070; red curve has no explicit legend.
source_findings.rationale: Retain multiscale weak-seller/absorption probabilities, strip penetration and reclaim. Do not identify unlabeled curve as CVD. Need causal same-horizon measurements and executable remaining payoff after rally starts.

source_findings.idea: Strongest trade claimed at **second retest**, after first demonstrates seller control. Mandatory HTF/LTF alignment asserted.
source_findings.rationale: Benchmark-only conjunction and first-versus-second retest comparison; user permits C/L entries without Response. Common opportunity cohort must count no-retest moves, deterioration, waiting cost and all rejected opportunities. Match first and repeated touches without treating touches independent.

source_findings.idea: Claimed 27% absorption failures without a reward system; three-tick replenishment/move in intended direction within three ticks of print. p4 schematic shows failed short at red upper zone, opposing buyers regain price and break above; tape schematic shows sequential red then green activity.
source_findings.rationale: Preserve source-specific rule as benchmark, percentage unverified and explicitly experiential on p14. Tick can mean price increment or event count; benchmark price-distance and three-event variants separately, never silently equate time/price. Measure failed opposite aggression and signed displacement independently.

source_findings.idea: CVD median/side check; source literally compares price with CVD median. p4 blue CVD zigzag mostly above rising white line, one dip below then recovery. No median formula, reset, units or lookback.
source_findings.rationale: Reject cross-unit price-versus-CVD comparison. Retain CVD versus its causal median/trend plus price trend as separate features; median and trend-line versions distinct hypotheses. Absorption-only-reversal rule is source benchmark, not universal: local pullback reversal can be HTF continuation (Jumbo/WIC/OFM).

source_findings.idea: Daily volume and delta profile; suppress near POC/interior, prefer shelves, ledges, LVN and minor nodes. p6 explicitly labels small local turn THIS IS NOT ABS; price later rises to VAH then drops. Previous-day VAH/VAL preferred over moving current-day values.
source_findings.rationale: Modify: absorption is a measured event independent of whether trade is useful. Compare profile family and location-dependent outcomes, including Jumbo/POC internal continuation. Freeze object versions; developing levels can still be causal/useful, and developing minor nodes also move. Do not call every shelf permanent or current VA meaningless.

source_findings.idea: High buy effort → passive sell wall → low reward → opposite sell aggression → retest of reward area with refresh before entry. Diagram p9 marks top green print, red horizontal wall, lower white retest band and subsequent decline.
source_findings.rationale: Retain full ordered sequence as later Response specialist; current Context uses effort/result histories and Location stores originating wall/retest area. MBP-1 supports at-touch replenishment proxies only; tape repetition cannot identify same participant or passive order inventory. Compare wall entry, opposite-flow entry and retest with remaining payoff.

source_findings.idea: Delta spike described as fastest confirmation at both VAH and VAL. Diagram uses the **same** label 'high delta spike of buyers ... absorbed passively by sellers' at upper and lower nodes, while lower price reverses up; text switches to buyers regaining control. Upper retest marks below high, lower marks around VAL after deep undershoot.
source_findings.rationale: Preserve directional ambiguity, do not infer mirror sign from copied annotation. Compare high positive delta plus poor upside result (bearish) versus positive delta plus upward result after negative flow (bullish), and negative sell spike plus low downside result. Delta is not guaranteed earlier than price; test first-detection latency on matched events.

source_findings.idea: Below-VAL departure → return to balance claimed 72–80%; author corrected estimate mid-sentence.
source_findings.rationale: Distinct hypothesis from ALM/MAV 80% definitions; report denominator, horizon, stop-before-reentry, depth and prior balance status. No empirical probability imported into model calibration.

source_findings.idea: Zones from clustered large aggressive prints (examples 60/80/100 contracts in seconds); repeated touches hold if defenders remain. p5 schematic has identical departure/return then hold/break branches.
source_findings.rationale: Retain causal aggression-origin objects with size/time/width construction, same-day and prior-day touch histories; extend to all size cohorts and cross-asset objects. Original clustering, merge/expiry, direction and hold/horizon definitions absent: independently specify, not claim reproduction.

source_findings.idea: Inventory defense/refill explanation asserted. p4 says offers absorb selling hitting bid (side error). p5 green aggressive-buy bubbles called absorbing red sellers; p10 schematic retains top bid bars while bottom bars consumed then replenished, without a calibrated book axis/time.
source_findings.rationale: Separate executed aggressive flow, passive bid absorption, net at-touch replenishment and latent retained inventory. Opposite aggressive trades do not themselves identify passive absorber. MBP-1 cannot prove participant persistence, off-touch queue or hidden refill. Test observable replenishment conditional on trade efficiency; causal mechanism remains hypothesis.

source_findings.idea: MNQ Jan10 2025 09:36–09:44 ET, ≥40-contract bubbles; repeated lows near 21,075 then recovery toward 21,120, several retries. NQ p7 red zone approx 29,812–29,827 formed early, revisit around09:40 plunges to roughly29,800 **below** zone before reclaim; green base~29,830 and rally.

source_findings.idea: Claimed199M ticks/235 RTH sessions Dec2024–Nov2025/41,152 touches; four families (~20 features): memory, construction, location, flow/state. All-touch42% hold,−.285R; selected deciles25–63%, AUC.63/placebo.51; flow-onlyAUC.54.

Reject numeric evidence as independently established or grounds to discard flow; target, cost and family controls unspecified. p9 compares whole-dataset all-touch events with selected OOS trades: re-run all baselines on same dates, opportunities and policy.

source_findings.idea: Tight bar bracket changed sign under within-bar fill ordering; eventual winners median18-tick penetration. Market312 fills PF.81/27.2%/−$405 versus limit64 fills PF1.80/68.8%/+$2,112 in Q1. Touch-or-through assumed limit fill.

Need **all** candidate excursions (losers and non-fills too), common ex-ante opportunity set, fixed versus entry-relative stop/target comparisons, fill bounds/latency and adverse-selection stress. Different filled subsets are part of policy value, not clean causal proof of passive inventory mechanism.

source_findings.idea: Configuration limit12ticks inside; stop32,target96,cancel30min,one position,1tick roundtrip costs+1tick stop slip. Train156/test79;542trades,+.143R,PF1.19,+78R,30%wins,6.8/day. p12 plot adds worst DD−16.6R; p13 two spikes~−1/+3 and11/16 five-session blocks positive.

Retain one-position and timeout lifecycle; test zero-trade days, fixed tick versus vol/zone-scaled depth, full sequential risk. Stop losses are not bounded in live gaps; source's 'nothing worse than stop' is simulation property. RTH restriction source-specific, not our architecture.

Different samples, hit rates, realized payouts and exits require trade-level reconciliation; stricter fills alone not established explanation. Full-year backtest includes tuning period, not full-year OOS. Regime explanation is post-hoc hypothesis; test vol interaction on other periods, no automatic low-vol veto.

source_findings.idea: Header Aggression-Memory Tick: rest_min30,variant3,entry_in12,t_minutes30,sl_ticks32,tp_ticks96. Net$2112.39,64trades,WR68.8,PF1.80,Sharpe.22,DD−1051.98,avg$33.01,maxwin$475.01,maxloss−$300.62. Equity$100k→~102112; source calls one contract 'compounding'.

A32tick one-NQ stop is$160 before costs; maxloss~$301 does not reconcile with claimed1tick stop slip, while maxwin~$475 fits96tick target less costs. Predictive first-touch feature is not inherently impossible; leak depends on field definition. Reverse split/rotating future-trained folds cannot establish deployable forward performance. Mechanism story and order sensitivity do not rule out overfitting. Shuffling after leaky feature generation may miss leaks; end-to-end placebo required.

source_findings.idea: p16 says first half/second half, conflicting156/79 split. Maintain untouched future after all inspection.

source_findings.idea: Topstep-style$50k target+$3k/trailing$2k,consistency,−4Rday,4000 daily resamples; p19plot400paths,static$48k line labeled trailing,typicalpassday27;$60/80/100pass96.7/92.2/85.7%. p20 bars for$40/60/80/100/120/150 instead99.8/98.3/95.0/90.1/85.4/79.6%;days60/39/28/21/17/12.

Retain account state-machine/path evaluation and fee/time-to-payout economics with official rules; daily PnL resampling alone loses intraday barriers. One-mini requirement makes continuous dollar-risk sizing unavailable without changing stop distances; no inherited sizing grid.

source_findings.rationale: Retain daily-stop counterfactual sequential replay; train-select and freeze stop objective, account overshoot and foregone rebound opportunities. Do not adopt−4R as proven optimum or uniformly14pp improvement.

source_findings.rationale: Reject universal payout cap and near-certainty claims; product rules determine limits. Under iid .955 per-account success, three would give99.9909%, not99.6%; staggering/dependence unspecified. Primary user objective one account/one mini, so copying/scaling excluded. source_findings.idea: Own limitations:79session regime slice,latestquarternegative,touch fills,cost simulations. References Harvey/Liu2014,López de Prado2018,Steidlmayer2003; no attached reproducibility package. Companion claims causal mechanical entries became−.16 to−.54R after hindsight removal whereas this paper says clean selection survives.
source_findings.rationale: Distinguish selected-touch prediction, entry generation, policy and simulator rather than declare global success/failure. Fresh experiments must resolve both claims; no numerical source claim used as design premise. Review original primary statistical methods separately. Marketing and mentorship performance are not evidence.

source_findings.idea: Aggressive print bubbles, NY AM NQ filter minimum30/maximum60 contracts adjusted for volume. Body bubble means result; wick bubble means absorption.
source_findings.rationale: Retain size-band and adaptive-quantile flow, impact/efficiency and origin objects. Include marketable limit executions, not just market orders. Final candle body/wick classification is available at close; no lookahead at print time. Bubble location alone cannot prove absorption, identity or intent; max60 excludes larger trades and needs explicit comparison.

source_findings.idea: Old aggression retest, memory, and catalyst at lowest/highest initial absorbed aggression. Repeated effort with no result → fast squeeze; initial squeeze fails → renewed same-direction squeeze.
source_findings.rationale: Retain causal multi-stage event history and aggression-origin Location family. p6 schematic is bullish first squeeze, pullback through catalyst, then bullish re-squeeze; 'other side of the failure' does **not** mean always reverse the initial squeeze direction. Test plain squeeze, failure fade, early refill and later re-squeeze separately. Executed orders are not still waiting; repeated prints do not establish same participant refill.

source_findings.idea: Early refill entry at lower prior aggression has higher claimed risk/reward; main long on re-squeeze with stop below newer aggression. Targets discretionary HTF objective,1–3R scalp plus trailing.
source_findings.rationale: Preserve distinct candidate times/locations and structural invalidation; source risk ranking unverified. Context/Location candidates can act earlier under user scope; later Response refinement compares remaining runway, waiting and non-fill costs on same initial opportunities. Risk also depends on stop distance, spread and volatility.

source_findings.idea: B+ short p7:40-range chart,27ticks risk/40target. Cleaner short p8:7tick/$35 risk,40tick/$200 target,5.71 ratio; original red catalyst near29890, white strip29903–04, actual bracket~29910, so not one identical line. p9 long drawing entry~29855,target127ticks/$635 and a **positive**97tick/$485 line above entry. p10 red path marks short~30561,stop~30584 after repeated failed pushes.

Selected B+/A+ examples and drawings are not executable logs or measured quality classes.

source_findings.idea: Replay short: balance, down squeeze, reclaim above catalyst then fail. Stop-limit below wick intended to require renewed selling; stop above intermediate wick; re-entry if thesis unchanged. p12 original shows one short~29901.75,stop29911.75 (10points/$200); panel unrealized−125 versus chart−155 at snapshot. p13 flat panel daily+$565 at lower objective; claims trail above each new aggression pocket to daily-profile VA.
source_findings.rationale: Retain pending-entry type, trigger/limit offsets, expiry, failed entry and bounded re-entry lifecycle for later Response. Stop-limit can trigger without sustained continuation and may fail to fill after gap; distinguish trigger from fill. Capture quote/tick latency, budget consumed by repeats, frozen target and confirmed new-pocket times. Snapshot PnL fields differ; no execution reconciliation supplied.

source_findings.idea: Passive failure variant: no large aggressive activity at failure, tape slows; long above buyers with stop below aggression. Caption says at take-profit, but enlarged original shows **open+1,−$20,daily$0**,entry29812.25,stop29798.25/−$280; target drawing$725/145ticks and risk$285/57ticks (one-tick offset). Replay speed x8, whereas first short replay was x1.
source_findings.rationale: Retain quiet-failure/exhaustion variant distinct from high-effort absorption. Missing filtered large prints is not absence of all aggressive trades. No completed target fill shown; do not label as winner or use drawing economics. Verify threshold-dependent missingness and whether slow tape adds beyond location/price.

source_findings.idea: Repeats RFE:199M ticks,235sessions,41,152touches;42%hold,−.285R baseline;AUC.63/placebo.51,flow.54,decile25–63;79sessions542trades+.143R/PF1.19/+78R;limit64trades68.8%PF1.80+$2112 versus market27.2%PF.81−405;full-year+$3803/PF1.45,negativeQ4−647/PF.76. Winner median18tick dip;recommended12tick-depth/32stop.
source_findings.rationale: Cross-reference RFE-04..10, not independent corroboration. Retain memory/construction/location/flow ablations and realistic action comparison; conditional winner excursion cannot set optimal stop/entry. Different entry policies generate different filled subsets. Replicate on common ex-ante opportunity population with joint costs and all outcomes.

source_findings.idea: No alpha needed in prop claim; positive or neutral expectancy plus risk geometry;−4R stop+14pp;~$2k structural payout cap;three accounts~99.6%certainty.
source_findings.rationale: Reject universal economics claims and need-for-PhD assertion. source_findings.idea: No systematic journal, assumptions/comparison and reliance on old books; define a discretionary box of allowed features and interrogate sessions, regimes, reversals/continuations. p8 red whiteboard actually says 'comparison', while prose says 'assumption'. source_findings.rationale: Retain explicit experiment scope, feature definitions and failure attribution; preserve both comparison and untested-assumption issues. Reject universal claims that old material or others' recordings have no value, that psychology is unquantifiable/unfalsifiable, or that all losses are data problems. Source itself cites1979 research. Operational behavior can be logged; no emotional-state inference about the user. Human coaching is not a production expert.

source_findings.idea: Risk should survive two or three unnoticed errors; fixed200 crossed out, quality-dependent size with logical targets, avoid sizing by cash need/feelings.
source_findings.rationale: Retain independent risk budgeting and fault tolerance, but no automatic2–3-loss safety guarantee or compulsory dynamic quantity. Primary position is one mini or flat; use entry selection, valid stop geometry and remaining loss headroom. Fewer trades alone does not mathematically lower win rate; extra confluence may help or harm. Repeated tiny-sample winner selection is not validated research and risks false discovery. Use registered families, chronological nested selection, dependence-aware intervals and held-out confirmation; no forced minimum daily participation.

source_findings.idea: Prop account modeled as a moving loss/payout barrier product;150 fee→2000 payout; five accounts with three payouts/two failures; variance allegedly sufficient without positive strategy expectancy.

Reject 'all prop accounts are demo', 'touch upper barrier means paid' and 'only two failed fees count'. Five initial fees cost750 under the example even before activation/reset/data/other charges; eligibility, caps, withdrawal effects and live conversion must be checked. Variance by itself proves no cashflow edge. Multi-account farming is outside primary one-account scope. Do not substitute account fee risk for the user's daily1000 loss objective.

Compare log return divided by return volatility or point displacement/ATR, and fixed horizons. Price rescaling and splits must not change normalized forecast. Mean/std ratio measures ATR relative stability, not simply high volatility; volThreshold1.5 input is unused. Zero/NA replacement0.0001 can fabricate extreme scores or false warmup data: output missing/abstain instead.

source_findings.idea: Oscillator pivots5 left/right, price evaluated at oscillator pivot bars, regular/hidden divergences within5–60 bars; negative5-bar plot offset. Plots defaultoff and directly gate divergence alerts; default delay-to-close false. Zero-score crossing alerts separate.
source_findings.rationale: Retain all four divergence alternatives with confirmation delay and distinction between oscillator pivot and independent price pivot. Display changes must not alter computation/alerts; current code violates that separation. Backdated labels are not earlier availability. Test future truncation, intrabar confirmation, missing/zero volumes, pivot ties and divergence horizon; compare soft multiscale features rather than only binary labels.

source_findings.idea: Only heading 'Pinescript-indicators-'; no documentation, provenance of numerical studies, images or extra operational requirements.
source_findings.rationale: Inventory/control only. Does not validate bundled statistics or give an architecture baseline.

source_findings.idea: Fixed decimal grid: each hundred +20/+80; 40-point bands around round hundreds, nearest 10 levels each side by default; confluence within 8 ticks.
source_findings.rationale: Retain round-number geometry as a benchmark Location family, with instrument-specific scale and matched offset-grid placebos. No evidence the same 100-point cycle generalizes across prices/assets/regimes. Grid is knowable in advance; latest-close display selection is not historical candidate availability.

source_findings.idea: Repair: bullish candle with lower wick <= default 0 ticks creates bullish marker at low; bearish candle with absent upper wick creates bearish marker at high.
source_findings.rationale: Retain wickless-origin/revisit hypothesis, separate from measured footprint unfinished auction or queue repair. Test bar construction, tick rounding, volume/flow context, retest hazards and continuation/reversal; source direction is a label, not demonstrated future return.

source_findings.idea: Fork: three bars, outer bodies <=0.5 range; opposite outer directions; outer lows/highs within 3 ticks; middle wick extends >=4 ticks beyond both. Signal known at third-bar close but drawn at middle extreme.
source_findings.rationale: Retain precise multi-bar sweep/reclaim shape and broader continuous features. Separate origin from confirmation/availability; test future truncation, symmetric cases, zero ranges and thresholds. C/L may propose entry independently; this price pattern is a possible future Response refinement.

source_findings.idea: Cross section: two same-direction bars, bodies >=0.6 range and >=40 ticks, first close/second open within 2 ticks, second close beyond first extreme; level midpoint of junction. Body gap: two consecutive nonoverlapping bodies >=4 ticks, regardless of wick overlap.
source_findings.rationale: Retain momentum-origin junction and body-gap families separately from three-candle FVG or actual untraded prices. Compare signed volume-at-price and structural context. The junction average can lie off tick grid; analytic location may be fractional but executable order price must be valid. Source thresholds remain benchmark settings.

source_findings.idea: On confirmed bars, check existing taps, then create patterns; first edge entry labels body gap 'filled'; caps400 markers/450 gaps and 1000-bar expiry. A+ shading09:30–11:00/15:00–16:00 NY. Table lists untapped objects by age, no performance statistics.
source_findings.rationale: Explicit lifecycle: touch/partial penetration/full traversal differ; a gap called filled here need not fill to far edge. Preserve failed/tapped/expired evidence. Display toggles currently gate detection/alerts; decouple. Pruning assumes origin-order, but fork added after same-bar repair can have older origin; enforce sorted expiry or scan. Confirmed-bar event queue preserves simultaneous messages, but window-open alert remains separate. All-session user scope stays open; A+ designation is unverified.

source_findings.idea: **Different engines:** plotted ADR uses reset on bar after `session.islastbar_regular`, zero-prefilled N-day average, plots reset-open ± full ADR. Statistics reset at `timeframe.change("D")`, wait for N ranges, then use daily-open ± ADR×scale/2.
source_findings.rationale: Retain average-range location benchmark only after making session, anchor, scale and warmup consistent. At default scale1 the table measures half the plotted distance; its probabilities do not validate the plotted lines. Different session boundaries can change ranges too. Test start mid-session, missing last bar, extended-hours setting, holidays/DST and equality (stats strict >/<).

source_findings.idea: 'Std Dev' bands are ADR multiples beyond plotted ±ADR (default total1.5/2/3 ADR), whereas table bases them beyond ±0.5ADR (default1/1.5/2.5 ADR). 'Fib' factors0.3/0.5/0.7 multiply ADR around open in both engines but can use different ADRs/anchors.
source_findings.rationale: Rename as range multiples; no statistical SD is calculated. Compare true empirical excursion quantiles and calibrated forward bands against these fixed factors. `std_x` changes stats base but not plotted ADR. Preserve each exact formula rather than merging all named SD/Fib levels.

source_findings.idea: Day-of-week counts: reach either/both sides, close beyond levels; optional band calculations controlled by display flags. Table sample parentheses show hit counts, not total trials, because formatter ignores first argument. `var row=1` increments on last-bar updates without resetting.
source_findings.rationale: Retain weekday/time conditioning as an experiment with shrinkage and dependence-aware uncertainty, not a profitability claim. Report numerator/denominator and conditional-versus-unconditional close probabilities. Fix presentation invariance, zero-count handling, persistent row overflow, stale/partial first range and chart-history sample selection; maintain canonical labels independent of drawing engine.

source_findings.idea: 08:00 NY open, weekdays08–12; prior completed daily percent-return sample SD over20 sessions via offset HTF request. Point sigma=open×daily SD%; first touch of ±0.25sigma; fixed ladder0.5/.75/1/1.5/2sigma.
source_findings.rationale: Retain daily-vol-scaled time/open reversion benchmark and compare richer forward volatility ensemble, alternate anchors/windows and calibrated conditional excursions. This is actual sample return SD, unlike range-multiple 'SD' in other members. Daily sigma is not itself four-hour remaining volatility or a normal touch probability. Session coverage and daily-close convention must be explicit.

source_findings.idea: First touch determines side/hour; search1-minute OHLC in order; ties infer first side by distance from open. Search for reversion to08:00 open starts **in the touch minute**, then later chart bars; chart-only fallback suppresses same-bar reversion.
source_findings.rationale: Preserve source sequence while marking unresolved within-minute ordering. A touch-minute low at open can precede upper touch, so same-minute reversion can still be false despite FIX-1 comments; nearest side is not observed order. Use ordered trade events or interval-censored/ambiguous outcomes, compare data-resolution cohorts fairly. Whole-chart-bar extreme used as MAE can include pre-touch/post-reversion movement; compute extrema only within causally ordered interval.

source_findings.idea: Hardcoded reversion rates for08h upper/lower78.4%n732/79.6%n774;09h69.7%n492/69.3%n488;10h47.6%n21/33.3%n27;11h0%n7/25%n4. MAE/MFE rows partly borrow09h/10h statistics for sparse bands; cumulative milestones reused for all non08h bands, including nonzero 'by09' after first touch at09h or later.
source_findings.rationale: Benchmark-only supplied claims; no raw study or dates. Changing touch multiplier/lookback/instrument leaves constants unchanged. Re-estimate event-time survival/competing risks with training-only hierarchical backoff and explicit provenance; a conditional reversion cannot precede its conditioning touch. Sparse-band borrowed distributions must be labeled and calibrated, not displayed as exact subgroup evidence.

source_findings.idea: MAE zones from open to quantiles conditioned on eventual reversion/non-reversion; MFE targets on opposite side after open reversion. Default bands use reverting MAE median/p75/p90 and nonreverting median/p75; maximum extension displayed relative to open.
source_findings.rationale: Retain joint excursion/outcome distributions and post-reversion continuation as separate targets. Outcome-conditioned quantiles do not directly give P(revert given current extension); derive posterior with priors and joint likelihood or train conditional model. MAE from open differs from adverse distance after0.25sigma entry. Current source labels TYPICAL/DEEP/RISK/NON-REV are interpretations, not proven boundaries; large configurable multiplier can make zone endpoints nonmonotone.

source_findings.idea: At12:00 settle no-touch/no-reversion; alerts lack closed-bar guard and touch message always says0.25sigma. Milestone clock uses timenow; reverted status marks every milestone done irrespective of actual reversion time.
source_findings.rationale: Keep horizon-specific labels and optional intrabar updates with historical/live parity; timenow belongs to display, decision clock to replay. Test first-bar touch after yesterday touched (previous-series flag can suppress alert), gaps, absent intrabars, same-bar dual touch and no-sigma warmup. 'Hard stop' here settles a study state, not an executed liquidation or account risk control.

source_findings.provenance: — CISD with fib or range extensions and stats.txt L103–116,197–268
source_findings.idea: Prior opposite candle body >=20% its own range (or current ATR threshold), plus open beyond close two bars back; optional prior volume>=1.5×current SMA. Track/update candidate opens during pullbacks; breaks of evolving structural high/low create opposing-open CISD references.
source_findings.rationale: Retain exact source price-delivery candidate as one variant, distinct from OSF HTF-sweep CISD. Specify finite-state transitions, dojis, simultaneous structural breaks and initialization from valid prices (source starts at0 and fallback may use NA candidate/index). Current ATR/volume benchmark paired with previous candle means intrabar threshold drift; choose explicit known-time policy and compare lagged normalization.

source_findings.idea: Range R=absolute difference of latest bull/bear CISD lines. Fibonacci up=bullLine+kR/down=bearLine−kR; Range up=bearLine+kR/down=bullLine−kR. Each new pair resets latest extension objects; default extension type None.
source_findings.rationale: Retain exact anchors and formulas with pair IDs/age; names alone do not determine which line is upper/lower. Compare extensions to calibrated excursions and matched placebo targets. Drawn5-bar length is not statistical expiry: hit tracking continues until replaced. Old references can form stale mixed-age pairs; require lifecycle/revision rules. No edge is established.

source_findings.idea: 'Hit' means close within0.5 current ATR of level, not wick touch, crossing or executable fill. One hit per current set; percentage cached only on new hit although denominator grows on every new set.
source_findings.rationale: Preserve close-proximity benchmark but relabel; dynamic tolerance changes event meaning. Cached percentages can overstate rates after misses; recompute numerator/denominator together. Define observation horizon, right censoring/replacement and direction separately; include formation-bar exclusion/ordering and non-hit cases. Set counts labeled sessions are not trading sessions.

source_findings.idea: Alert toggles (defaultfalse) control level completion, opposite-level creation and currentState; bull alert setting fires bearish break and vice versa. With keepLevels=true alert code examines index0 (oldest), while extensions use newest. New alert flags set after reset can persist into next-bar extension pass.
source_findings.rationale: Reject direct reuse until state/presentation/notification are separated. Test toggle invariance, exact-once events, oldest/newest reference behavior, duplicate pair regeneration on next bar, no-NA initialization, replay and intrabar rollback. Default table state stays bearish absent alert-triggered state updates; it is not a trustworthy independent trend estimate. Unconditional clearing inside plotExtensions also prevents keepLevels from preserving old extension history.

source_findings.idea: Smart Trail: trend-flow midline=(2×HMA20+double-WMA(5,8))/3, slope versus9 bars, ±0.618/1×price SD24. Trend Catcher recursive SuperSmoother50 slope; Tracer20-bar Donchian midpoint. Strength actually clip((close−VWMA14)/ATR14,−2,2)×50 despite obsolete ADX comments.
source_findings.rationale: Retain distinct smooth-trend, location-distance and range-midpoint benchmarks; do not count correlated price transforms as independent evidence. Exact units and warmup required. Price SD bands are not calibrated forecast/reversal probabilities; compare forward-vol and conditional residual bands, slope horizons, lag and costs.

source_findings.idea: Volatility=cap(25×100×ATR14/close,100), static30/80 categories. Squeeze=absolute detrended regression45/max100, halved outside BB45-inside-KC(ATR20×1.5). Bar volume assigned wholly by close versus range midpoint, then candle/tick rule fallback. Dashboard 'sentiment' uses unsigned volume: +2V ifV>=50, −2V otherwise.
source_findings.rationale: Preserve volatility/BB-KC compression and OHLC sign proxy separately; dashboard volume sentiment loses direction and is an absolute-size threshold, not buy percentage. Replace with measured trade signs and cohort volumes, robust normalization by session/activity. Squeeze score mixes momentum magnitude with compression and is not probability; isolate both inputs in ablations.

source_findings.idea: Gaussian lag kernel helper defined but unused. Active reversal bands use one-sided rational-quadratic24-lag smoothing (h8,r2), width average of ATR24 and mean absolute historical-price distance to **current** kernel center, multipliers1.5/2.5. NeoCloud uses365-bar ATR ratchets3/7/15 and midpoint envelopes, display shifted+1.
source_findings.rationale: Retain causal kernel residual/range location family and compare simpler EWMA/rolling quantiles. 'Neural Probability Channel' contains neither fitted neural model nor probability calibration. Preserve current-center dispersion definition; different from historical forecast residuals. Cloud display offset does not mean future information exists; stable object versions needed when bands migrate. Unused Gaussian helper is implementation reference only.

source_findings.idea: Nine typical Supertrend factors sensitivity−4..sensitivity step0.5; EWMA10 of prior-side×current price change ranks performance; 3-cluster k-means up to251 passes chooses mean factor of highest cluster, normalizes positive mean performance by EMA abs return for adaptive line.
source_findings.rationale: Retain online expert-selection hypothesis with common directional-return surrogate, compare fixed factors, uniform mixture, exponential weights and learned gate on net executable outcomes. No trading cost/drawdown objective in ranking. Empty clusters, sensitivity1 onlyonefactor, zero denominator and persistent fallback need fixtures. Computation restricted by `last_bar_index−bar_index<=2500`, so historical availability depends on future chart length: remove end-relative cutoffs for replay/causality. Current-bar return can update a next-decision gate if available; it cannot justify a pre-return entry.

source_findings.idea: 'Neural' score: six hand-coded inputs (DEMA momentum, ALMA alignment, confirmed10/10 pivots, two20-bar extreme blocks, ADX30>=60 regime, OHLC volume sign), three tanh units with fixed hand-chosen weights then sigmoid. No fitting/data/training labels.
source_findings.rationale: Retain feature hypotheses and fixed-score benchmark, compare calibrated logistic/GAM/trees/MLP only with labels and nested tuning. Input quality is not established by AI naming. Because raw score lies within±1.2, sigmoid output lies about0.2315–0.7685: A+ threshold0.80 is unreachable. Score is not a win probability. Test attainable grades, overflow, missing pivots/zero ATR, signal rarity and calibration.

source_findings.idea: Supertrend direction flips plus optional one named filter produce labels; scoring functions containing rolling/stateful calculations are called only inside conditional signal branches and separately for buy/sell.
source_findings.rationale: Modify to compute all underlying time-series every event, then select signals. Conditional calls can make EMA/pivot/history state represent sparse signal executions rather than every chart bar; confirm parity before any use. Pivot references have10-bar delay. Chart visibility gates position state, filter correlation is high, and no rule requires all families agree. Source signals are opportunities to evaluate, not mandated multi-confirmation entry eligibility.

source_findings.idea: Exit markers are EMA9/21 cross with recent RSI14 extreme>60/<40, not actual RSI divergence. Position merely remembers last signal and is not reset on exit. SignalMode input unused; Short-Term/Mid-Term autopilot options mismatch branch strings with spaces, Long-Term matches.
source_findings.rationale: Preserve momentum-decay exit as future management alternative with q1 close, compare holding/target policies. Repair unused/mismatched UI and exact-once exit state before benchmark; no fills, positions, P&L or training demonstrated. Source 'optimal' sensitivity and quality claims unsupported.

Compare equal-duration/time-shifted/activity windows and training-only discovery with multiple-testing control; do not import names as market regimes or erase gaps09:30–09:55/11:49–12:35/17–18.

'Fib' arrays here hold vertical time markers, not price Fibonacci levels. No demonstrated reversal/raid probability. Test sensitivity to small clock shifts, session overrides (inner clocks stay fixed), DST repeated/skipped times and month/year rollover.

Repeated draw calls for statistics recreate same sessions; Cinderella gets additional draw3 and DST-dependent path. Utilities/10 imported but implementation absent from ZIP.
source_findings.rationale: Modify to explicit event/session accumulators and known calendar end, separate calculation from rendering. Test partial startup, long/seconds sessions (timeframe.multiplier treated as minutes), missing bars, duplicates and display invariance. Duplicate draw paths can create/delete competing objects; visual history is only1 session and cannot prove historical signal availability. Imported clearing/day/pip helpers remain unreviewable from supplied bytes; no execution/compile claim.

source_findings.idea: Weekday arrays accumulate completed H−L; date is first outside-session bar's weekday. Table uses mean ranges, refreshes at day change, and 'Total Sessions' reports only Moana counts. Range/TSD toggles exist but no true-SD table/calculation is implemented.
source_findings.rationale: Retain conditional empirical range measurement, distinguish observation of whole-window range from future extension forecast. Require per-window coverage/trial counts, correct overnight trading-day assignment, prior-only reference histories, uncertainty and recency controls. No hits, reactions, directional forecasts or economic tests present. Source comment 'all14sessions' does not create absent14th setup.

Daily `close` is not automatically settlement. Offset daily request is causally appropriate once prior bar complete; define vendor calendar/roll convention and no partial initial day. Higher extensions are source-specific choices.

Many derived levels share one HLC source and are correlated. From-top daily mode stores gz_50 as 'low' and gz_618 as 'high' though reversed, so containment check cannot succeed; sort bounds explicitly and test reflection/scale/translation invariants.

Use explicit session-entry Boolean, NY clock, frozen open, index keyed by trading day; replay historical/final/live parity and display-history-cap invariance.

source_findings.rationale: Retain opening-position and ongoing path state as Context features, compare continuous normalized distances and hierarchical partitions. Threshold can be wide relative to daily range; overlapping categories depend on precedence. Freeze opening zone at true open and preserve later transitions separately; missing categories must abstain/backoff, not silently inherit selected-zone stats.

source_findings.idea: All overall tables are hardcoded for claimed2482days: touch/close, continue/reject, first-touch identity/continuation/time, repeat touches, daily/inter-pivot GZ touch, close distribution, highest/lowest pivot. Examples Ptouch57.5%, Pcontinue88.1%, Preject61.7%; S3 first-touch continuation100%.

Continue and reject are clearly not complements; close rates have ambiguous denominators and differ from separate close distribution (R1 39.8% versus aboveR1 24.5%). First-touch and maximum-level entries partly repeat, not independent validation. Reconstruct ordered competing/multi-event outcomes with hysteresis for repeated touch, elapsed time/censoring, conditional denominators and uncertainty; no return inference from high continuation percentage.

source_findings.idea: Gap defined relative to prior daily high/low (not prior close): above20.5% withR1touch65.9/R2 42.1/S1 15; below11.3% withS1 71.5/S2 55.2/R1 12.1; inside68.2% withP69.5/GZ71.7/R1 35.2. Text advises gap-direction continuation, no opposing trades.
source_findings.rationale: Retain outside/inside prior-range Context and target reach hypotheses; separate price gap from range gap, reclaim and failed-break paths. Hardcoded rates do not prove directional trade value; target may lie behind opening price and touch may be reversion. Compare continuation/reversal conditional on open location and observed path, without adopting blanket direction bans.

source_findings.provenance: — Daily High Low probability zones.txt L14–44,88–102,113–169
source_findings.idea: For last250 complete days, map each day's final high/low into prior range coordinates u=100×(price−priorLow)/(priorHigh−priorLow); twelve25%-wide bins−100..200, plus outside tails. Plot same bins from current prior-day range; highlight modal high/low bins.
source_findings.rationale: Retain empirical extreme-location distribution benchmark for P-zone research; compare conditional/joint H/L distributions, quantile bins, volatility-standardized coordinates and regime/session/path updates. Final extreme occupancy is not touch or conditional reversal probability. Current observed high imposes support constraints on final-high forecast; unconditional histogram does not update them. Zero-range prior days need explicit eligibility; minimum5 is source display rule, not sample sufficiency.

source_findings.idea: Daily array request includes current daily element with lookahead_off; logic runs only at last chart bar and assumes index1 is yesterday. Highest-count bin tie goes to earliest; tails retained numerically but merged in table and excluded from modal selection. Day-end=day-start+24h.
source_findings.rationale: Canonical completed-day snapshots replace request-state ambiguity: historical last bar before day close may expose previous completed daily array while realtime exposes developing current array, shifting assumed index. Verify historical/live parity explicitly. Retain separate upper/lower tail mass and abstain from arbitrary highlighted bin when all counts zero; modal bin may contain little mass. Calendar end replaces24h across DST/holidays. Rounding can prevent displayed percentages summing100; exact probabilities plus uncertainty needed.

source_findings.idea: Prior completed daily/weekly H/L/midpoints via offset security. Default sessions **UTC+0**: New York13–22, London07–12:45, Asia00–07; completed-session H/L/midpoints retained outside window.
source_findings.rationale: Retain completed range references and relative ordering as Context/Location features. These named sessions are fixed UTC defaults, not NY/London DST calendars; do not silently equate them to original Jumbo or RTH windows. Display/range toggle controls whether session values exist; decouple and test warmstart, final-bar inclusion, cross-midnight and missing opening bar.

source_findings.idea: Time opens00:00/08:00 use exchange timezone independently of session UTC setting; code takes chart open during1-minute time flag, then max(open) within it. Filter tests chosen reference1>reference2, default AsiaHigh>LondonHigh. Menu includes weekly IB levels absent from resolver.
source_findings.rationale: Retain inter-session ordering, scheduled opens and broader continuous distance features. Freeze source objects at explicit decision time, do not conflate08:00 exchange with NY open. Missing-menu implementations must return structured unsupported state, not silent NA. Exact lower-timeframe opens need canonical source data and date reset; sourcezero initial values/equal-day-open event suppression are unsafe defaults.

source_findings.idea: On `change(time("D"))`, source 'green/red day' compares **current first chart bar** close versus its open (or retained08:00 open), then increments once; flags reset samebar. It never measures preceding full-day final close here.
source_findings.rationale: Reject statistics as evidence of stated daily-close target. Preserve intended daily/NY-open-to-daily-close conditional forecast, repair labels using separately frozen opening anchor and actual later end close, then train at known checkpoint. Compare all-day, remaining-day and first-bar direction as separate tasks. Test synthetic days with first bar opposite full-day direction, stale08:00 anchor, zero/flat outcomes and filter availability; sourcecounts are not repeated everybar becauseflags reset.

source_findings.provenance: — Daily statistical range and levels.txt L8–13,67–125
source_findings.idea: Default level-measurement23:00–21:00 UTC; hit-study09:30–16:00 same UTC. For completed up sessions manipulation=O−L/distribution=H−O; down sessions manipulation=H−O/distribution=O−L; dojis excluded. Expanding pooled mean/median/SD of these outcome-oriented distances.
source_findings.rationale: Retain favorable/opposing-side excursion distributions as Context/Location hypotheses, rename without implying manipulation or order. Final close direction labels historical outcomes, never a known current-day direction. No guarantee opposing extreme occurred first or was smaller. Compare directional joint extremes, first-excursion order, conditional mixtures and quantile forecasts; include doji category and volatility/session normalization.

source_findings.idea: Plotted levels freeze at **levels-session open** ± mean/median distances, mean+1SD and distribution mean+2SD; labels recompute as statistics change. Hit counts instead compare **stats-session open** ± pooled distances, not displayed23:00-open levels.
source_findings.rationale: Keep exact anchors separate and fix label/line/statistic identity before use. Statistics cannot validate a different plotted opening anchor/horizon. Stats may change during custom overlapping windows; version/freeze forecasts at formation and compute hits against that object, including formation-bar ordering. SD is calculated here, but normal coverage/reversal probability is not justified for nonnegative skewed excursions.

source_findings.idea: Hit flags once per stats session, numerator updates intraday, denominator atsession end regardless of forecast readiness. Weekly reset requires Monday session start AND previous chart bar notMonday, generally false with Monday pre-session bars. Flags reset only at end.
source_findings.rationale: Modify observation accounting: denominator counts eligible completed outcomes, current session separate; do not emit0% for missing sample. Intraday numerator can exceed completed denominator; missing end can carry oldflags. Calendar week/session IDs replace bar weekday condition. Test holidays, overnight/custom windows, restart, missing boundaries, unready forecasts and exact-once updates. Weekday-conditioned hit rates remain unvalidated.

source_findings.idea: Separate currentRTH O/H/L/mid, completed priorRTH O/H/L/C/mid and ON H/L/mid. Imported czoa/SetSessionTimes/1 selects contract sessions but source absent; returned timezone ignored by time() call. Engine runs only within last_bar_time−5days despite comment3days.
